scope: Optional original R103/R104 full text-paint screen. All 480 pairs retain source, options and independent targets; generated sources avoid copying 960 SVG files. Complete canonical RGBA digests retain exactness without copying another native PNG bank.
rgbaContract: Straight RGBA8, width/height checked separately; RGB under zero alpha is canonicalized to zero exactly as PixelComparer ignores it.

nativeCapture.recipe: Embed two separate regular/400 and Mono/700 style elements, Image.decode, drawImage to transparent 160*outputScale by 80*outputScale canvas, DPR1. Source and native-context hashes are retained per input.
nativeCapture.referencePolicy: Original Windows and Linux PNG/RGBA identities remain frozen. The four existing hash-bound Linux CORE-MATH companions are selected only on recognized hosts. Fresh captures agree with qualified pixel targets; encoded PNG differences remain separate from pixel exactness.
